purpose: Source registry for architectural measurement and proportion records used only as procedural grammar reference.

extraction_policy.hard_rule: If a source has beautiful drawings but no usable dimensions or scalable proportions, record it as inspiration-only and do not extract measurements from it.

sources.institution: New Advent / Robert Appleton Company 1907 text
sources.license_or_access_note: Online transcription of early twentieth-century reference text; use here is limited to factual proportional reference.
sources.notes: Used for named arch categories and qualitative geometry constraints such as semicircular, segmental, horseshoe, lancet, equilateral, drop, and four-centered arches.

sources.source_title: An Attempt to Discriminate the Styles of Architecture in England, 7th edition
sources.institution: Internet Archive scan via Wikimedia Commons
sources.license_or_access_note: Public-domain historical treatise scan; used only for named English pointed arch form distinctions.
sources.notes: Useful for pointed arch class distinctions. No drawing artwork or plate geometry was copied.

sources.source_title: Vitruvius: The Ten Books on Architecture
sources.license_or_access_note: Public-domain translation distributed by Project Gutenberg; used for column-order proportional rules only.
sources.notes: Used for order-based column height-to-diameter ratios.

sources.source_title: The Architecture of A. Palladio; in Four Books
sources.license_or_access_note: Digitized historic architectural treatise; used for proportional order rules only.
sources.notes: Used for normalized column-order proportions. No plates copied.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific public web page with concrete dimensions; facts used as measurement reference only.
sources.notes: Used for Gothic nave span and vault-height proportions, not as a drawable design source.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific dimensions page; values used only as measurement reference.
sources.notes: Used for Gothic nave width and vault-height proportions.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific public page with concrete dimensions; values used only as measurement reference.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific page with concrete arch span ranges; values used only as measurement reference.
sources.notes: Used for Roman round-arch arcade span examples. Rise was not extracted where the source did not provide it.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific official page with concrete octagon dimensions; values used only as measurement reference.

sources.license_or_access_note: Building-specific dimensions page; values used only as measurement reference.

sources.license_or_access_note: Engineering landmark page with concrete dome dimensions; values used only as measurement reference.

sources.license_or_access_note: Library of Congress HABS documentation PDF; used only for factual dimensional notes where explicit dimensions appear in the written data.
